package.name: g1_arm_ik_core
package.description:
Pure-Python kinematics for one Unitree G1 arm (7 DOF): URDF parsing, forward kinematics, CasADi/IPOPT position-only inverse kinematics, and ROS-free command shaping / safety logic.
Deliberately has NO ROS dependency in the algorithm modules, so the maths can be unit-tested offline. The ROS 2 nodes are in g1_arm_ik_node and g1_arm_control_node.
